whyChooseTitle: We Treat Your Garden Like Our Own
whyChooseIntro: Our designs are not just about aesthetics; they are about creating spaces that feel alive, that breathe with the rhythm of the natural world.

whyChoosePillars.title: Personal Expertise
whyChoosePillars.text: With years of hands-on experience, I bring a personal touch and deep knowledge to every garden design project.

whyChoosePillars.title: Dedicated Approach
whyChoosePillars.text: As the sole creator behind Balga Designs, I work closely with each client to ensure every garden is uniquely tailored to their needs.

whyChoosePillars.title: Passion for Sustainability
whyChoosePillars.text: I am committed to sustainable practices, designing gardens that not only look beautiful but also support the local ecosystem.

howWeWorkSteps.title: Consultation
howWeWorkSteps.text: We begin by understanding your garden’s unique qualities and vision, ensuring the design harmonises with the natural ecosystem.

howWeWorkSteps.title: Planning
howWeWorkSteps.text: We craft a detailed plan, blending aesthetic beauty with sustainable practices to create a garden that thrives long-term.

howWeWorkSteps.title: Execution
howWeWorkSteps.text: We carefully bring the design to life using eco-friendly materials and methods, ensuring lasting beauty and sustainability.
